patthana16.47:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: …pe… anidassanaappaṭighaṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na sahetuko ca na anidassanasappaṭigho na sahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
